Ryan Gosling to play MCU's Ghost Rider, Marvel announces new films

Marvel Studios announced Ryan Gosling will portray Ghost Rider in an upcoming film, with Shawn Levy set to direct. The studio also revealed David Jonsson will take on the Black Panther mantle. These announcements were made at San Diego Comic-Con, outlining the next phase of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The Ghost Rider film is slated for a 2028 release.
